a) the dynamic disturbances due to the load mass can be rejected by the PID controller, b) the load mass and its inertia can be increased to a certain level without destabilizing the system, and c) the transient partial contact mechanics will not induce instability if the load is lifted at a sufficiently low speed.
a helicopter with PID control can be made stable to a load disturbance, and the load disturbance is stable to a load mass.
a helicopter can be used to grasp an object while hovering and transition into laden free-flight without touching the ground.

the development of aerial manipulation capabilities that enable a UAV to grasp, carry, and release an object during flight.
developing a framework for aerial manipulation that will allow for the safe, reliable and stable grasping and lifting of objects while hovering.

the stability bounds of a hovering helicopter are sufficiently large to enable aerial manipulation.
